name: Calculadora de Take Profit e Stop Loss
tagline: Calcule níveis de preço de take profit e stop loss
description: Enter your entry price, leverage, and margin to instantly calculate PnL for up to 3 take-profit levels and a stop loss. Shows Risk:Reward ratio and estimated liquidation price. Works for both long and short positions.
metaTitle: Calculadora de TP/SL – Ferramenta de Cálculo de Take Profit e Stop Loss
metaDescription: Insira o preço de entrada e parâmetros de risco para calcular níveis de take profit (TP) e stop loss (SL) com relação risco-recompensa.
